svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Introduction to Kubernetes, slide 12 of 12: From Compose to Kubernetes
svg.desc: From Compose to Kubernetes: a Compose service becomes a Deployment plus a Service, ports and the nginx proxy become a Service plus an Ingress, volumes become a PersistentVolumeClaim, .env.prod becomes a ConfigMap plus a Secret, healthcheck becomes readiness and liveness probes, restart: unless-stopped becomes a self-healing Deployment, deploy.resources.limits becomes resources requests and limits, and docker compose up -d becomes kubectl apply -f.
svg.text: Everything you know from docker-compose.prod.yml already has a Kubernetes name.
